egress.terms: Metered per plan, roughly 1x-2x storage: HD 1 1TB->1TB, HD 4 4TB->5TB, HD 12 12TB->22TB, HD 24 24TB->50TB. Store page notes "only outgoing traffic is counted to the limit (UL), incoming (DL) is not counted". Over-limit = throttled, no overage bill.

interface_detail: SSH/SFTP/FTP, 40 Gbps HDD line, app installer, VNC
chaining: Mount and front; Plex/Emby unlock only from HD 7 up
limits_note: Egress byte cap ~2x storage; streaming apps gated below HD 7
reliability_note: NL, long-running. Constant per-TB rate across the range means no volume discount to chase — the 24 TB tier is only marginally cheaper per TB than HD 4.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: corroborates storage/traffic pairs and the UL-only counting rule

binding_note: no constraint in the record binds at this scale; the record carries no limit of a kind the vocabulary names
